title: SUNation Energy, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: SUNation Energy, Inc. (SUNE), a small-cap solar energy company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to its secured revolving line of credit with related party MBB Energy, LLC, including a six-month maturity extension and a 50% capacity increase from $1M to $1.5M, as well as a debt conversion agreement allowing up to $1.2M of Long-Term Note debt to convert to restricted common stock at a 10% premium to market.
key_points: Line of Credit Agreement amended on April 14, 2026: maturity date extended 6 months from April 15, 2026 to October 15, 2026
Line of Credit capacity increased by 50% from $1,000,000 to $1,500,000 with MBB Energy, LLC
Debt Conversion Agreement approved for conversion of up to $1,200,000 of Long-Term Note debt to restricted common stock
Conversion shares issued at $1.77 per share, representing a 10% premium above the April 13, 2026 closing price
Conversion shares issued to CEO Scott Maskin and CFO James Brennan, both related parties and affiliates
Debt conversion reduces outstanding secured debt under Long-Term Note by approximately $1,200,000
